verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents recurring payroll that runs automatically after initial setup, with alerts and review/approval before paychecks go out. This is a genuine first-party recurring job, but it is limited to payroll for salaried employees on direct deposit. Its HR automation with custom approval chains covers multi-step processes, but nothing shows those can be scheduled to recur. Missing for 10: general-purpose scheduling of arbitrary recurring jobs or workflows, scheduling controls for HR or other workflows, programmatic or agent-driven scheduling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
